name: Måneskin

whyMatters.en: Rome four that took Eurovision and TikTok-era covers into global alt/indie hard-rock revival: Beggin' (cover hit) and I Wanna Be Your Slave (2021) put Italian glam-garage attitude on 2020s streaming rock radio.
whyMatters.zh: 罗马四人组：把 Eurovision 与 TikTok 期翻唱推进全球 alt/indie hard-rock 复兴——Beggin'（翻唱热单）与 I Wanna Be Your Slave（2021）把意大利 glam-garage 态度钉上 2020 年代流媒体摇滚电台。

lyricQuotes: I wanna be your slave / I wanna be your master
Put your hands up in the air

shortBio.en: Rome glam-garage four; Eurovision Zitti e buoni, Beggin' and Slave as 2020s streaming rock hits.
shortBio.zh: 罗马 glam-garage 四人；Eurovision Zitti e buoni，Beggin' 与 Slave 作 2020 年代流媒体摇滚热单。

body.en:
Formed 2016 in Rome (Monteverde). Teatro d’Ira era and Eurovision 2021 win with Zitti e buoni put the four on continental TV. Beggin' (Four Seasons cover, live-in-studio style) becomes a 2020–21 streaming breakout; Teatro d’Ira - Vol. I yields I Wanna Be Your Slave—glam shout, De Angelis bass-forward mix, Raggi riff.

Rush! (2022) adds The Loneliest ballad. Craft is 70s hard-rock/glam attitude through indie-modern production and social-video distribution, not progressive complexity.
body.zh:
2016 年于罗马（Monteverde）组建。Teatro d’Ira 期与 2021 Eurovision 凭 Zitti e buoni 夺冠，把四人推上欧洲电视。Beggin'（Four Seasons 翻唱，现场录音室风）成 2020–21 流媒体爆发；Teatro d’Ira - Vol. I 产出 I Wanna Be Your Slave——glam 喊叫、De Angelis 贝斯靠前混音、Raggi riff。

Rush!（2022）加入 The Loneliest 谣曲。工艺是 70 年代 hard-rock/glam 态度经 indie-modern 制作与社交视频分发，非 progressive 复杂度。

title.zh: 经流媒体与 Eurovision 的 glam-garage

body.en:
Måneskin write short glam-hard-rock songs with David’s shout vocal and De Angelis bass as mix center—closer to Stones/Zeppelin attitude than indie whisper.

Beggin' shows cover economy in the TikTok window; Slave and Zitti e buoni show original catalog punch.

Distribution path is TV contest + streaming, not 90s college radio.
body.zh:
Måneskin 写短 glam-hard-rock，David 喊叫人声、De Angelis 贝斯作混音中心——更近 Stones/Zeppelin 态度，非 indie 耳语。

Beggin' 显示 TikTok 窗口的翻唱经济；Slave 与 Zitti e buoni 显示原创目录冲击。

分发路径是电视赛事 + 流媒体，非 90 年代学院电台。

title.zh: 同学以来稳定罗马四人

body.en:
David/De Angelis/Raggi/Torchio form as teens and hold. No classic fracture—same four from street busking through Eurovision and Rush!.

Writing credits often shared; stage roles fixed.

Peak global unit is 2021 Teatro d’Ira / Eurovision year.
body.zh:
David/De Angelis/Raggi/Torchio 青少年组建并稳住。无经典分裂——从街头到 Eurovision 与 Rush! 仍是四人。

写作常共享；舞台角色固定。

全球巅峰单位是 2021 Teatro d’Ira / Eurovision 年。

title.zh: 2020 年代欧洲摇滚电台面孔

body.en:
Cite path: 70s glam/hard-rock vocabulary through Italian language and social video. Peers to Strokes/Arctic Monkeys revival energy with different geography.

Influenced list still forming; immediate impact is proving rock four-piece can chart in streaming decade.

Craft debt is riff simplicity + visual brand consistency.
body.zh:
引用路径：70 年代 glam/hard-rock 语汇经意大利语与社交视频。能量上邻 Strokes/Arctic Monkeys 复兴，地理不同。

influenced 名单仍在形成；即时影响是证明摇滚四人组能在流媒体十年上榜。

工艺债务在 riff 简洁 + 视觉品牌一致。
